title: [KBM] New editor: honor the PowerToys language setting

status.label: Manual review completion required
status.detail: Eight actual automated requests are verified. The final result contains substantive analysis and one published whitespace-normalization concern; it was grounded as optional hardening, answered and resolved. Normal Settings selections supply fixed language tags or the empty system-default tag, and no supported whitespace-writing path or resulting startup failure was established. No required upstream correction is proposed, but zero unresolved threads is not the required fresh zero-comment result. Manual completion remains necessary, including exact-revision build and startup validation; an unavailable review tier is not the reason.
